scope: Opt-in dark preview of the local web app, matching the existing analysis report palette with readability refinements
behavior: Only theme=dark sets data-preview-theme. All added styles are scoped to that attribute. The default theme stays light. No analysis, upload, history or results behavior was changed.
reference: reports/openra-game/index.html root palette: #0f172a background, #111827 panel, #e5e7eb foreground, #94a3b8 muted, #60a5fa accent

visual_review.notes: Layout kept. Dark card boundary, clearer input border, active tab underline and readable helper text make task entry distinct without changing the report's color family.

visual_review.surface: File input and expanded advanced settings
visual_review.notes: Drop zone, selection message, secondary buttons, native selects and optional name field use coherent dark surfaces. No source uploaded during this preview review.

White card background left over from the light theme was reproduced in computed browser styles and fixed after a failing regression. Game headings are 16px and descriptions 13px; result links remain unchanged. History cards were also checked in the actual browser.

selected_color_contrast_ratios.limit: Selected computed colors checked mathematically; this does not establish complete accessibility compliance or validate every hover/disabled/error state.

tests.command: py -3.10 -m pytest tests/test_web_inputs.py tests/test_web_jobs.py tests/test_web_app.py tests/test_web_ui.py tests/test_web_integration.py -q --tb=short
tests.native_environment: .NET on PATH and compatible GAME_SI_TEST_CLANG_LIBRARY configured
tests.red_observed: Dark activation and palette initially failed; card background and control readability regressions also failed before their fixes.

independent_code_review: Passed after the readability refinements; no critical, important or minor findings within this scoped preview
preservation: Original bright stylesheet rules, existing layout, analysis results and stored records were not replaced. No Git changes were committed or pushed.
